title: 第15章 仙术师第16章 仰慕你很久了
content_zh:
第15章 仙术师
二小姐这一道临危不惧的幽冥斩如同噩梦一般，终结了鄂尔多斯的生命，“暴击－250”
“嗷~~~~~！”
系统提示：玩家（蝶恋花）杀死君主级BOSS鄂尔多斯，获得经验200W点（队友跟班二号分享50W点），获得声望100点，奖励金币80枚，因为是第一名杀死君主级BOSS的玩家，附加奖励魅力值+1、幸运值+1……
这一声系统提示就仿佛天籁一般，在刘烨耳畔响起，虽然不是自己亲手杀死BOSS，但是这个感觉却如此的美妙，我可爱的二小姐真是太聪明了！
“哈哈…，二小姐，我们成功了！”刘烨搂着二小姐娇嫩的身体，激动道。
“嗯，我们好厉害！”叶雨蝶的俏脸同样兴奋，不过她的目光却紧紧地盯着刘烨，闪烁着异样的光芒，“不过……你是不是可以把我放开了？”
刘烨一愣，急忙把二小姐香喷喷的身体放开，那种柔软香滑的感觉让他有些不舍，“失误，纯属失误~！”
“哼，看在你帮助本小姐的面子上，今天就不跟你一般见识了！快去看看爆了什么好东西，最好给我一把厉害的短剑！”叶雨蝶活蹦乱跳的朝着鄂尔多斯尸体冲过去，扑进了金币推里。
刘烨淡笑一声，杀死鄂尔多斯以后，二小姐已经14级，自己虽然只得到25%的经验，但也达到了13级，距离14级已经不远了，还是杀BOSS升级最快啊！
感叹一声，刘烨怀着激动的神色跑过去，对于君主级BOSS的宝物充满好奇，“二小姐，让个空，让我看看都爆了什么好东西？”
只见叶雨蝶兴奋的像个小女孩，飞快的把战利品往自己背包里塞，直到背包变满之后，才不甘心的停下来，看向刘烨，“六哥，背包里放不下了，这些东西暂时交给你保管，是暂时哦！”
“好好好！”刘烨无奈的点头。
“嘿嘿…，这些东西都是我的！”二小姐满意的娇笑一声，说道。
刘烨也没有浪费时间，迅速的将战利品清扫一遍，经过两人的合计，鄂尔多斯一共爆出十件装备，其中橙色装备四件，紫色装备四件，还有两件是蓝色装备，除此之外，还有五个强化卷轴和一大堆大瓶红药和大瓶蓝药，声望之心*5，游戏币总价38金币，还有一大堆副职业材料……
刘烨看着直流口水，这可都是宝贝啊！龙族BOSS身上的油水果然牛叉，可惜跟班注定命苦，只能看着，不能吃！
“声望之心都给你了，金币也给你吧，这些刚才都奖励过了，这些材料我自己留着，母亲大人看到一定会很高兴的，药剂分你一半，强化卷轴的话……算了，给你一个物防卷轴吧！至于装备，先看看属性吧！”
二小姐自顾自的分配着，顺手将装备属性分享在队伍频道中，一连串的装备属性让人眼花缭乱：
【龙甲护肩】（橙色装备）
等级：12

耐久度：150/150
基础属性：魔法防御+12、生命值+25
附加属性：智力+2、精神+2
【龙牙短剑】（橙色装备）
等级：15
耐久度：178/178
基础属性：物理攻击+38、魔法攻击+60
附加属性：精神+12、敏捷+5
特效：[幽冥斩+1]
【龙纹靴】（橙色装备）
等级：12
耐久度：150/150
基础属性：速度+12、闪避+8
附加属性：敏捷+5、耐力+2
【荧光护盾】（橙色装备）
等级：12
耐久度：138/138
基础属性：物理防御+10、魔法防御+10
附加属性：精神+6
特效：[幽冥斩+1]

四件极品橙色装备让刘烨口水横流，奈何这些橙装都在二小姐的背包里，只见二小姐得意的指着四件橙装说道：“真的有短剑，太好了，这个是我的了！荧光护盾也是我的，护肩给姐姐用，至于这个鞋子……奖励你了！”
“多谢二小姐！”见二小姐如此慷慨，刘烨急忙接过龙纹靴，将身上的精致皮靴换下来，速度顿时暴涨，不愧是12级橙色靴子，属性就是给力。
其他三件刘烨没有理会，短剑和盾牌都是智士的装备，自己拿来也没用，而且这个盾牌主加精神属性，明显就是给智士准备的！
（在封神的九大职业中：骑士、牧师、智士这三个职业是可以佩戴盾牌的。）
接下来是四件紫色装备，经过一番激烈的争执，刘烨好不容易要到一件紫色护肩：
【金丝护肩】（紫色装备）
等级：12
基础属性：魔法防御+10、魔法值+20
附加属性：智力+2
属性还算不错，总比自己身上的5级护肩强，换下来之后，跟班二号的属性有了实质性的变化。
除此之外，刘烨还分到5枚声望之心，38枚金币，还有一个物防卷轴，使用五枚声望之心一共获得36点声望，38枚金币再次让自己的腰包鼓了起来。
至于物防卷轴，刘烨也没有吝啬，刚好皇族面具还有一条强化空位，使用之后成功添加了一条（物防+5）属性！
捡了大便宜的二小姐笑的很开心，相当的开心，好在最后两件蓝色装备没有进入她的法眼，全都丢给了刘烨，是一件属性不错的15级拳套和法杖，自己虽然用不上，但是正义之师的兄弟们却可以用得上。
于是，刘烨直接将自己身上多余的装备丢进了公会仓库，顿时引起了大震动，公会频道霎那间沸腾起来：
“副会长威武，这么多好装备，太帅气了！”
勇者无敌自然也看到了入库提示，泪流满面的感激道：“跟班兄弟，这些装备真是雪中送炭啊！今天刷副本刚好可以用上。”
“勇哥太见外了，我现在怎么说也是副会长不是？”刘烨笑道。
“够兄弟，今天如果能够拿下副本记录，以后兄弟们都听你的！”勇者无敌说道。
“不用这样的……”刘烨不好意思的说道。
“兄弟不要推辞了，就这么定了！”勇者无敌坚定的说了一声，直接关闭了公会频道，带领着楚留香等人开始练级。

刘烨无奈一笑，正义之师这些玩家还真是可爱，这才刚来几天？这么快就要当会长了？
这时，只听身前的二小姐忽然间惊呼起来，“哇嘎，本小姐上等级榜了！”
刘烨一愣，好奇的外，等级榜上已经有六个14级玩家，用不了多久，罪恶丛林副本就要开刷了！
等级榜的变动自然引起了不小的轰动，世界频道里很多人都在谈论蝶恋花这个ID，二小姐这边很快便收到了枫叶林公会成员的询问。
小丫头嚣张的在公会频道里炫耀着，一股脑将得来的装备和材料扔进了公会仓库，引来阵阵欢呼：“二小姐威武~！”
“雨蝶，怎么回事？”叶夫人惊喜的问道。
“母亲，雨蝶刚才杀了一个很厉害的大BOSS，厉害吧？”二小姐得意的问道。
“真是太好了，看样子我们今天的副本进度能够提前一些时间了！”大小姐神话轩轩兴奋道。
…………
此时的新手村鬼雾林外，在魔法小猫的带领下，九玄月火急火燎的朝着悲鸣山洞赶去，当她听说有隐藏职业任务以后，急忙放下一切事情赶过来，没准还有机会！
“好嚣张的小子，我倒要看看你究竟有多厉害，连我们中锋的隐藏职业都敢抢！”九玄月咬牙说道。
“姐姐不好了，雨蝶丫头上等级榜了，BOSS已经被她干掉了！”魔法小猫惊呼道。
九玄月脸色一寒，急忙准还有机会！”
“嗯！”魔法小猫乖巧的点头，姐妹两个拼命向悲鸣山洞赶过去。
…………
话说悲鸣洞穴里面，二小姐得意的在公会频道里炫耀着自己的功绩，越笑越开心，特别是得到姐姐和母亲的赞赏，小丫头开心的像个小女孩。
刘烨没有去打扰她，而是静静的注视着二小姐可爱的表情，好一个极品萝莉，可惜太捣蛋了些……
忽然间，二小姐的脸色变得气愤起来，狠狠地关闭公会频道，愤恨道：“该死的，月落和乌啼两个太嚣张了，竟敢质疑本小姐的能力？早晚要收拾他们！”
“额……，”刘烨无奈的摇摇头，看来落月和乌啼两位帅哥要倒霉了，“美丽可爱的二小姐，我们是不是可以解救这位美丽的NPC了？”
闻言，二小姐的目光忽然间怪异起来，不爽的盯着结界里的仙术师，气鼓鼓的说道：“哼，她有本小姐漂亮吗？”

刘烨愕然，急忙拍拍马屁：“当然是二小姐漂亮，她这种胭脂俗粉怎么可以和二小姐比肩？”
“这还差不多！”
只见二小姐满意一笑，从背包里取出一支金色的羽毛，在结界旁边确认使用，金色的光芒瞬间笼罩了整个山洞，结界解除，仙术师美迪缓缓睁开眼睛。
“姐姐，你醒了！快把隐藏职业给我吧！”只见二小姐邪恶一笑，霸气侧露的说道。
仙术师美迪刚刚醒来，正要说几句感慨的话语，却被二小姐这句话给震到了，“额……倒是个着急的小姑娘，既然你是有缘人，我自然会把职业传承交给你的！”
“快点啊姐姐，我已经等不及了！”小丫头急切道。
美迪展颜一笑，洁白的玉手轻轻挥动，撒下一道金色的光辉，将蝶恋花包裹其中，“仁慈的孩子，继承我们仙术师的意志吧！”
不一会，蝶恋花成功的转职了，只见二小姐兴奋的睁开眼睛，甜甜的笑道：“谢谢你姐姐，以后有人欺负你记得找我，我是落日城的大姐大，还有个很厉害的打手！”
“咯咯……，”仙术师美迪笑道花枝招展，满眼深意的看了刘烨一眼，说道：“可爱的小丫头，等你20级的时候，可以到落日城王宫找我学习仙术，姐姐还有些事情，再见了！”
说完，仙术师美迪轻松凝结一个手印，眨眼间消失。
“我擦，这个技能帅气啊！二小姐以后学了这个技能，跑路的时候就轻松多了！”刘烨忍不住惊呼道。
却见二小姐根本没有听她说话，而是嚣张无比的拿起手中的短剑，叫道：“二号，你已经不是我的对手了，本小姐现在可厉害了！”
“额……小丫头的屁股痒痒了？”刘烨无语的看向二小姐。
“哼，本小姐现在不怕你了，打败你我就是大姐大！”二小姐嚣张的仰起头。
刘烨忽然脸色一变，急忙说道：“二小姐，魔法小猫杀过来了！”
“别骗我了，那丫头已经被我打跑了！”
“是真的，还有九玄月！”刘烨无奈的说道。
“是吗？”二小姐眉头一皱，估疑的转过身，只见九玄月和魔法小猫脸色难看的出现在山洞中，恶狠狠的盯着这边。
二小姐大惊失色，急忙躲在刘烨身后，怯怯的说道：“六哥…，帮我挡住他们，我要跑路！”
“二小姐放心，六哥是无所不能的，玄月不是我的对手！”刘烨撇嘴一笑，对于二小姐的捣蛋已经习惯了。

Chapter 15 Immortal Magician
The second lady's Nether Slash, which was fearless in the face of danger, was like a nightmare, ending Ordos' life, "Critical hit - 250"
"Ouch~~~~~!"
System prompt: The player (Die Lianhua) kills the monarch-level BOSS Ordos, gains 2 million experience points (teammate shares 50W points with the No. 2 teammate), gains 100 reputation points, and is awarded 80 gold coins. Because he is the first player to kill the monarch-level BOSS, additional bonuses are charm value +1, luck value +1...
This system prompt sounded like the sound of nature in Liu Ye's ears. Although he did not kill the BOSS himself, the feeling was so wonderful. My lovely second lady is so smart!
"Haha...Second Miss, we succeeded!" Liu Ye said excitedly, hugging the Second Miss' delicate body.
"Well, we are so good!" Ye Yudie's pretty face was equally excited, but her eyes were fixed on Liu Ye, shining with a strange light, "But... can you let me go?"
Liu Ye was stunned and hurriedly let go of the second lady's fragrant body. The soft and smooth feeling made him a little reluctant to let go, "Mistake, purely a mistake~!"
"Hmph, for the sake of helping this lady, I won't be as familiar with you today! Go and see what good things have been exploded. It's best to give me a powerful dagger!" Ye Yudie rushed towards Ordos' corpse and threw himself into the gold coin pusher.
Liu Ye smiled lightly. After killing Ordos, the second lady was already level 14. Although he only got 25% of the experience, he had reached level 13. He was not far from level 14. Killing the BOSS was the fastest way to level up!
With a sigh, Liu Ye ran over with excitement, full of curiosity about the treasures of the monarch-level BOSS, "Second Miss, give me a break and let me see what good things have been exploded?"
Ye Yudie was as excited as a little girl and quickly stuffed the loot into her backpack. When the backpack became full, she reluctantly stopped and looked at Liu Ye, "Brother Six, there is no room for it in the backpack. I will leave these things to you for safekeeping for the time being!"
"Okay, okay!" Liu Ye nodded helplessly.
"Hehe... these things are all mine!" the second lady said with a satisfied smile.
Liu Ye did not waste time and quickly cleaned up the loot. After the two of them combined, a total of ten pieces of equipment were revealed in Ordos, including four orange pieces, four purple pieces, and two blue pieces. In addition, there were five enhancement scrolls and a lot of large bottles of red medicine and blue medicine, 5 reputation hearts, a total game currency of 38 gold coins, and a lot of sub-professional materials...
Liu Ye drooled when he looked at it, these are all treasures! The oil fruit on the dragon boss is really awesome, but unfortunately the followers are doomed to have a hard life, they can only look at it but not eat it!
"I've given you the heart of reputation and the gold coins. I've rewarded you just now. I'll keep these materials for myself. Mother will be very happy to see them. I'll give you half of the potion. If you want to strengthen the scroll... forget it, I'll give you a physical defense scroll! As for the equipment, let's take a look at the attributes first!"
The second lady was minding her own business and shared the equipment attributes in the team channel. The series of equipment attributes was dazzling:
[Dragon Armor Shoulders] (orange equipment)
Level: 12
Durability: 150/150
Basic attributes: magic defense +12, health +25
Additional attributes: Intelligence +2, Spirit +2
[Dragon Tooth Dagger] (orange equipment)
Level: 15
Durability: 178/178
Basic attributes: physical attack +38, magic attack +60
Additional attributes: Spirit +12, Agility +5
Special effect: [Ghost Slash +1]
[Dragon Pattern Boots] (orange equipment)
Level: 12
Durability: 150/150
Basic attributes: Speed +12, Dodge +8
Additional attributes: Agility +5, Stamina +2
[Fluorescent Shield] (orange equipment)
Level: 12
Durability: 138/138
Basic attributes: physical defense +10, magic defense +10
Additional attributes: Spirit +6
Special effect: [Ghost Slash +1]
Four pieces of top-quality orange equipment made Liu Ye drool. However, these orange equipment were all in the second lady's backpack. The second lady proudly pointed to the four pieces of orange equipment and said: "There is really a dagger, great, this is mine! The fluorescent shield is also mine, and the shoulder pads are for my sister. As for these shoes... I reward you!"
"Thank you Miss Second!" Seeing Miss Second's generosity, Liu Ye hurriedly took over the dragon pattern boots and replaced the exquisite leather boots on his body. His speed suddenly increased. They were indeed level 12 orange boots, and their attributes were awesome.
Liu Ye ignored the other three items. The dagger and shield were both equipment for wise men, and it was useless to bring them by themselves. Moreover, the shield had spiritual attributes, so it was obviously prepared for wise men!
(Among the nine major professions of the Gods: knight, priest, and wise man, these three professions can wear shields.)
Next came four pieces of purple equipment. After a fierce argument, Liu Ye finally got a purple shoulder pad:
[Golden Shoulder Pads] (Purple Equipment)
Level: 12
Basic attributes: Magic defense +10, magic value +20
Additional attributes: Intelligence +2
The attributes are pretty good, better than the level 5 shoulder pads on my body. After replacing them, the attributes of Follower No. 2 have substantially changed.
In addition, Liu Ye also received 5 reputation hearts, 38 gold coins, and a physical defense scroll. Using the five reputation hearts, he gained a total of 36 reputation points, and 38 gold coins once again bulged his pockets.
As for the physical defense scroll, Liu Ye was not stingy. There happened to be an enhancement slot in the royal mask, and after using it, it successfully added an attribute (physical defense +5)!
The second young lady who had picked up a big deal smiled very happily, quite happy. Fortunately, the last two pieces of blue equipment did not enter her eyes, and they were all thrown to Liu Ye. They were a level 15 glove and a staff with good attributes. Although she could not use them, the brothers of the Master of Justice could.
So, Liu Ye directly threw his extra equipment into the guild warehouse, which immediately caused a big shock, and the guild channel suddenly became excited:
"The vice-president is mighty, he has so many good equipments, he is so handsome!"
The Brave Invincible naturally also saw the storage prompt, and said with tears in his eyes: "Brother, these equipment are really a timely help! I can just use them when I finish the dungeon today."
"Brother Yong is too outspoken. How can I say that I am also the vice president now?" Liu Ye said with a smile.
"Brother, if you can get the dungeon record today, brothers will listen to you from now on!" said the brave man.
"There's no need for this..." Liu Ye said sheepishly.
"Brother, don't refuse, it's settled!" Brave Invincible said firmly, directly closed the guild channel, and led Chu Liuxiang and others to start leveling up.
Liu Ye smiled helplessly. Players like the Master of Justice are really cute. How many days have they been here? Are you going to be the president so soon?
At this time, the second young lady in front of me suddenly exclaimed, "Wow, I'm on the ranking list!"
Liu Ye was stunned and curious. There were already six level 14 players on the level list. It won't be long before the Jungle of Sin dungeon will be launched!
The change in the level list naturally caused quite a stir. Many people on the World Channel were talking about the ID of Die Lianhua. The second lady soon received inquiries from members of the Maple Leaf Forest Guild.
The little girl showed off arrogantly in the guild channel, throwing all the equipment and materials into the guild warehouse, which attracted cheers: "Second Miss is so powerful~!"
"RainDie, what's going on? Mrs. Ye asked in surprise.
"Mother, Yudie just killed a very powerful BOSS. Isn't it amazing? "The second lady asked proudly.
“That’s great, it seems like our progress on today’s copy can be advanced some time! "The eldest lady, Shinhwa Xuanxuan, said excitedly.
…………
At this time, outside the Guiwu Forest in Novice Village, Jiuxuanyue, led by the magic kitten, hurried towards the Wailing Cave. When she heard that there was a hidden professional mission, she hurriedly dropped everything and rushed over. Maybe there would be a chance!
"What an arrogant boy, I want to see how powerful you are. You even dare to steal our center's hidden profession! Jiu Xuanyue gritted her teeth and said.
"My sister is in trouble, Yudie is on the level list, and the BOSS has been killed by her! ” exclaimed the magic kitten.
Jiuxuanyue's face turned cold, she must have had a chance if she hurried! "
"Yes!" The magic kitten nodded obediently, and the two sisters rushed towards the Screaming Cave.
…………
Speaking of which, inside the Screaming Cave, the second young lady proudly showed off her achievements in the guild channel. The more she smiled, the happier she became. Especially when she received praise from her sister and mother, the little girl was as happy as a little girl.
Liu Ye did not bother her, but quietly watched the second lady's cute expression. She was such a top-notch lolita, but she was too mischievous...
Suddenly, the second lady's face became angry, she closed the guild channel fiercely, and said angrily: "Damn it, Yue Luo and Wu Ti are so arrogant, how dare you question my ability? Sooner or later, we will deal with them!"
"Um..." Liu Ye shook his head helplessly. It seemed that the two handsome guys Luoyue and Wu Tiao were going to be in trouble. "My beautiful and lovely second lady, can we rescue this beautiful NPC?"
Hearing this, the second young lady's eyes suddenly became strange. She stared at the magician in the barrier unhappily and said angrily: "Humph, is she as beautiful as me?"
Liu Ye was stunned and hurriedly flattered her: "Of course the second young lady is beautiful. How can she, a rouge-fashionable girl, be on par with the second young lady?"
"That's pretty much it!"
